title: Attune cascade combined 310-clip inspection

scope.label_status: weak source labels / acted labels; not reviewed gold

cascade.name: attune-cascade:sensevoice+emotion2vec+aed+vocalsound-probe+fsd50k-probe
cascade.affect: emotion2vec+ acoustic SER; transcript lexicon excluded
cascade.events_styles: SenseVoice AED UNION frozen VocalSound linear probe UNION frozen FSD50K linear probe
cascade.merge_rule: Deterministic set union by channel and label in AED, VocalSound, FSD50K order; later duplicates are suppressed. Scream remains a discrete event, not shouting. Sob remains an event, not crying_speech.
cascade.timestamps: whole utterance only; no word or frame localization

cascade.span_policy: whole-utterance weak labels and predictions; no localization score

aed_only.span_policy: whole-utterance weak labels and predictions; no localization score

probe_only.span_policy: whole-utterance weak labels and predictions; no localization score

limitations: Both probes are closed-set and have no evaluated OOD or abstention threshold.
All event/style spans are whole-utterance provisional spans.
Weak source labels are not reviewed Attune gold.
FSD50K standalone events do not establish speech-embedded style coverage.
CREMA-D DIS maps to Attune other, never distress.
